g.text: Timing drift and cue breaks, Voxtral against Whisper

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: 7 timed references, SRT at the default cue config (gap_s 1.2, max_chars 28); the Whisper column is turbo-nocond, measured before large-v3 became the Whisper default.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: Voxtral is the default because drift (p95, slope) is the failure a user cannot fix, while cue breaks are a tunable heuristic. Source: timestamps.md.
